Emulator **1.3.0** · 2026-10-21 · Python 3.13.11 · run on a clean source tree.

The project's own checks of this television: a byte-for-byte replay of every captured request, the unit tests of its adapter, and its contract held to the captures. They are not validation, which only a session with a real app gives ([ledger](../manual-validation.md)); open-source clients are reported apart ([clients](../open-source-clients.md)).
